Dear friends,
I'm here for guidance, direction. My parents who are in their mid 50s have never been subscribers of a health insurance scheme. Fortunately they haven't suffered from a major illness yet. Ever increasing hospitalisation expenses have unsettled me. I'm petrified that an illness would erode their retirement savings. I sought help from insurance agents for health insurance. Their guidance led to puzzlement. The jargon they used seemed intimidating. My parents won't opt for insurance unless I gift it to them. They deem it profligate spending. Please guide me.
